description.value:
“Those Serbian bastards have done it again! This beast’ll be perfect for crushin’ those gonks down the block. Aside from the heavy as borg-balls frame, the jams, the terrible sights, the awkward grip, and the over-under double auto-barrel sounding like you’re fuckin’ a dishwasher, it’s fantastic! Plus, it’s all I could afford.”

Cost: 500eb (Expensive)

Class: PQ Machine Gun • Skill: Heavy Weapons • Range: Battle Rifle

Damage: 4d6 • Capacity: 36 • ROF: 1 • Hands: 2

Alt. Firing Modes: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Concealable: No

Slots: 2 • Attachments: Sling, Sniping Scope • Mods: None

Special Features: All ammunition fired from this weapon also functions as Explosive Ammunition, including its -2 Attack Check penalty and inability to make Aimed Shots. When fired in Single Shot, this weapon expends 3 rounds in a burst. If there are not enough rounds left in the magazine for Single Shot or Autofire, using either expends the entire magazine. Reloading this weapon requires two Reload Actions. Requires BODY 10+ or paired Cyberarms to not reduce MOVE by 2 while wielded.

Range: Battle Rifle
Pre-installed: Sling, Sniping Scope (effects already included in these stats)
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Gun 4), Suppressive Fire

Foundry notes:

  • Its range tables come from this module's DV Tables compendium; run the module's "Use Corgo's 77 DV Tables" macro once per world (see the module README).

From Corgo's 77 Collection V3 by Corgopolis (Weapons > Weapon Catalog).
